title: Abortion and the unborn
tagline: How to understand and explain the Church's teaching on unborn life, with respect for women and for those who disagree.
whyItMatters: Abortion is one of the most painful topics, and many people in any room have been touched by it. This course helps you speak the truth about the unborn child and the mother together, and points to real help.

mindset.tip: Assume the person may have a story. Listen first; a friend, sister or you may be carrying a loss. Never use statistics as a weapon (James 1:19).
Ask questions that invite thought, such as 'what do you think makes a human being valuable?'. Trent Horn's talks model this tone.
Name the woman's needs and fears as real. Offer practical help and know where to send someone (Option Line, Women Deserve Better).
Do not leave out mercy: the Church offers healing to those who have had an abortion (CCC 2270-2275; Evangelium Vitae 99).
Separate the science of when a human life begins from the question of how we should treat human beings. Be honest about which is which.

resources.title: Evangelium Vitae
resources.creator: Pope John Paul II
resources.why: The Church's main teaching on the value and inviolability of human life, from conception to natural death.

resources.title: Declaration on procured abortion
resources.creator: Congregation for the Doctrine of the Faith
resources.why: A shorter 1974 statement of the reasons the Church gives, including from reason alone.

resources.title: What the Early Church Believed: Abortion
resources.creator: Catholic Answers
resources.why: Short survey of how the first Christians spoke about abortion.

resources.title: The Didache
resources.creator: Unknown (early Christian text)
resources.why: One of the earliest Christian writings, with a plain prohibition of abortion and infanticide.

resources.title: Persuasive Pro-Life
resources.creator: Trent Horn / Catholic Answers

resources.creator: Trent Horn / Catholic Answers
resources.why: A practical list of questions that keep a conversation going instead of a fight.

resources.title: Do Humans Gradually Become Persons? (with Randal Rauser)
resources.creator: Trent Horn and Randal Rauser / Catholic Answers

resources.title: Secular Pro-Life
